name: Visitor's Permit / Business Visitors Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Travel must be for tourism, business, short-term study, research, consultancy, medical grounds, or as a yacht owner/crew member, per Immigration Act 2003 s.9(3).

outcome.duration_length: 21 days on arrival for Australia/NZ/Singapore/USA nationals under the Business Visitors Permit; 14 days for other visa-exempt nationals under s.9(3)

sources.title: Department of Immigration, Fiji -- Visit Fiji / Business Visitors Permit / Fiji Permits index: 21-day on-arrival permit for Australia/NZ/Singapore/USA nationals, 14 days for other visa-exempt nationals under Immigration Act 2003 s.9(3), not extendable -- must convert to a work permit to stay longer

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Fiji). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 Department of Immigration sourced. This permit is explicitly NOT extendable -- a visitor who wants to stay longer must convert to a different permit category (e.g. work), not renew this one. Separate Special Purpose Permits exist for medical grounds and yacht owners/crew, disclosed here rather than modeled as their own files given thin available detail.
